Name: Water Flowers and Sea Plants
Author: otohimexoxo
Description:
adds 9 different water flowers as forage items and 6 different sea plants as fishable items (along with color variants for some of the flowers) ❀♡

. ☆  . • ☆ . ° .• °:. *₊ ° . ☆

[img]https://imgur.com/4pncZL1.png[/img]
1. install content patcher and farm type manager
2.﻿ download this mod
3. unzip contents into stardew's mod folder

[img]https://imgur.com/e6yXfxu.png[/img]
♡ the flowers can be found at the forest, beach, mountains and in the secret woods
♡ all of the sea plants can be found at ginger island (north and south waters) since my last mod that adds new fish added a lot to the beach already ^^;
♡ compatible with all mods that add any of the same items
♡ sprites made by me

[b][size=4][u]Water Flowers Included:
[/u][/size][/b][spoiler]♡ Lotus (comes in pink, purple and orange)
♡ Marsh Marigold
♡ Water Forget-Me-Not (comes in blue, purple and white)
♡ Water Hibiscus (comes in red and white)
♡ Water Hyacinth
♡ Water Iris (comes in purple, light purple and white)
♡ Water Lily
♡ Water Poppy
♡ Yellow Pond-Lily[/spoiler]

[b][size=4][u]Sea Plants Included:
[/u][/size][/b][spoiler]♡ Purple Coral
♡ Red Algae
♡ Sea Anemone
♡ Sea Fan
♡ Sea Whip
♡ Soft Coral[/spoiler]
